topic.name: 声音的频率与传播测量
topic.title: 从一段波形到一湖钟声，怎样测量声音？
topic.question: 从一段波形到一湖钟声，怎样测量声音？
topic.description: 按相同时间窗比较do与sol的频率，主动采集自己的声音，再用闪光和水下钟声复现教材测速。

sources.title: Geneva Science History Museum — Jean-Daniel Colladon

zh: 声音的频率与传播测量

translations.从一段波形到一湖钟声，怎样测量声音？: How do waveforms and a bell across a lake reveal sound?
translations.按相同时间窗比较do与sol的频率，主动采集自己的声音，再用闪光和水下钟声复现教: Compare do and sol over the same time window, capture your own sound, and reproduce the textbook’s flash-and-underwater-bell timing experiment.
translations.把次数和时间真正对齐: Align the counts and the time
translations.湖上闪光与水下钟声: A flash and an underwater bell
translations.计算机显示等时长声音波形，或两船用闪光和水下钟声计时: Equal-duration sound waveforms on a computer, or two boats timing a flash and an underwater bell
translations.听到水下钟声，停止计时: Hear the bell; stop the clock
translations.看到闪光，开始计时: See the flash; start the clock
translations.点击后才请求麦克风；短片段仅保存在当前页面。: The microphone is requested only after your click. Short clips remain in this page.
translations.等待麦克风，随后采集短片段: Waiting for microphone access before capturing a short clip
translations.采集完成，波形保存在本页: Captured; the waveform stays in this page
translations.未识别稳定音高，仍可观察实际波形: No stable pitch detected; the actual waveform is still shown
translations.麦克风不可用，可继续使用合成示例: Microphone unavailable; synthetic examples remain available
translations.声音播放不可用，波形仍可观察: Audio playback unavailable; the waveform remains visible
translations.看到光后等候声音: Sound delay after seeing the light
translations.波形示例使用教材某乐律中的264与396赫兹，频率比为3比2；它们是合成信号，不: The synthetic waveform examples use the textbook tuning’s 264 and 396 Hz, a 3:2 ratio; they are not presented as recordings. Autocorrelation estimates stable microphone fundamentals from 80 to 1000 Hz, leaving pitch blank when none is detected. The 14 km and 10 s lake values come from the textbook’s simulated exercise, not the original historical measurements. Apparatus and horizontal/vertical scales are illustrative. Light travel takes about 47 microseconds, negligible for this exercise.
translations.这条图线是同一测量位置的信号随时间变化。: The trace shows a signal at one measuring point changing over time.
translations.同样的时间宽度里，sol完成更多次振动。: Over the same duration, sol completes more oscillations.
translations.同一窗口中do有10个周期，sol有15个周期。: The same window contains ten do cycles and fifteen sol cycles.
translations.同时发出光与水下钟声: Emit a flash and underwater sound together
translations.接收船看到闪光后立即开始计时。: The receiving boat starts timing when it sees the flash.
translations.钟声在水中传播，计时器记录两次接收之间的延迟。: Sound travels through water while the clock measures the arrival delay.
translations.14千米除以10秒，得到约1400米每秒。: Fourteen kilometres divided by ten seconds gives about 1400 metres per second.

cues.title: 先保存一个do音
cues.caption: 这条图线是同一测量位置的信号随时间变化。
cues.captionEn: The trace shows a signal at one measuring point changing over time.
cues.zh: 教材建议录下两个乐音，再暂停观察振动图像。先看这里明确标注的合成do示例，频率是二百六十四赫兹。横轴是时间，曲线不是声音在空间中走过的道路。自由探索可以真正采集自己的短片段。
cues.en: The textbook suggests recording two notes and pausing their waveforms. Begin with this explicitly synthetic do example at two hundred sixty-four hertz. The horizontal axis is time: the curve is not the sound’s path through space. Exploration can capture a real short microphone clip.

cues.title: 并排保存一个sol音
cues.caption: 同样的时间宽度里，sol完成更多次振动。
cues.captionEn: Over the same duration, sol completes more oscillations.
cues.zh: 再加入三百九十六赫兹的sol示例。两条图使用完全相同的时间宽度，因此可以比较周期的长短。sol在同样时间里完成的振动更多，说明频率更高；不要把波形在竖直方向的高低当成音调。
cues.en: Add the sol example at three hundred ninety-six hertz. Both traces share exactly the same time width, allowing a fair period comparison. More sol oscillations fit into that duration, showing a higher frequency. Vertical amplitude should not be mistaken for pitch.

cues.title: 框住do的十个周期
cues.caption: 同一窗口中do有10个周期，sol有15个周期。
cues.captionEn: The same window contains ten do cycles and fifteen sol cycles.
cues.zh: 把矩形时间窗设成do的十个完整周期，约三十七点八八毫秒。在同一时间内，sol完成十五个周期，所以频率比是十五比十，也就是三比二。这采用教材列出的某种乐律数值，不把它说成所有调律都完全相同。
cues.en: Set the rectangular window to ten complete do cycles, about thirty-seven point eight eight milliseconds. Fifteen sol cycles fit into that same interval, giving a frequency ratio of three to two. These are the textbook’s particular tuning values, not a claim about every tuning system.

cues.title: 同时发出光与水下钟声
cues.titleEn: Emit a flash and underwater sound together
cues.caption: 接收船看到闪光后立即开始计时。
cues.captionEn: The receiving boat starts timing when it sees the flash.
cues.zh: 换成教材模拟的湖上实验。两条船相距十四千米，发射船敲响水下钟，同时发出闪光。另一船通过水下听音器接收钟声，并在看到光时开始计时。光的传播时间相对于十秒的声延迟很小。
cues.en: Now use the textbook’s simulated lake experiment. Two boats are fourteen kilometres apart. Strike the submerged bell and emit a flash together. The receiving boat listens through an underwater horn and starts its clock on seeing the light, whose travel time is tiny compared with the sound delay.

cues.title: 等待水下声音到达
cues.caption: 钟声在水中传播，计时器记录两次接收之间的延迟。
cues.captionEn: Sound travels through water while the clock measures the arrival delay.
cues.zh: 观察水下波前向听音器靠近。画面压缩了船间的巨大距离，纵向水深也不是同比例。计时器显示的是模拟的实际秒数。钟声到达听音器时停止计时，教材给出的等待时间是十秒。
cues.en: Watch the underwater front approach the listening horn. The drawing compresses the large boat separation and uses a different vertical scale. The clock shows the simulated elapsed seconds. Stop when the bell is heard; the textbook gives a ten-second delay.

cues.title: 用路程除以传播时间
cues.caption: 14千米除以10秒，得到约1400米每秒。
cues.captionEn: Fourteen kilometres divided by ten seconds gives about 1400 metres per second.
cues.zh: 忽略约四十七微秒的光程，十四千米除以十秒得到约每秒一千四百米。这里复现的是教材模拟数据，不是把它当作当年原始记录。自由探索可改变距离与接收延迟，检查计算中千米和米是否统一。
cues.en: Neglecting about forty-seven microseconds of light travel, divide fourteen kilometres by ten seconds to obtain about fourteen hundred metres per second. These are the textbook’s simulated values, not the historical raw record. Change distance and delay in exploration while keeping the units consistent.
